I’m analyzing the placement of tiles, focusing on the source seed being in the top-right position, specifically tile #2 horizontally. It seems likely that the pattern will repeat to the left. I need to check the dimensions of the panels first. Panel1 is 9x6 with a seed of 3x3 repeated 3x2, seeded at the top-right. Panel2 is 8x6 with a seed of 2x2 positioned at the bottom left. Panel3 is 6x8, possibly seeded at the bottom/right. So, to create the output grid, I must use original dimensions of 26 rows by 22 columns, and I need to make adjustments within specified rectangles, incorporating zeros and colored values. For Panel1, the row indices are from 2 to 10, and columns from 3 to 8. I’ll build a repeating pattern for those rows.

g=[[8]*22 for _ in range(26)]
a=[[0,1,0],[1,0,1],[1,1,0]]
for r in range(9):
 for c in range(6): g[2+r][3+c]=a[r%3][c%3]
b=[[4,0],[4,4]]
for r in range(8):
 for c in range(6): g[4+r][13+c]=b[r%2][c%2]
cpat=[[3,0,3,3],[0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,3]]
for r in range(6):
 for c in range(8): g[16+r][3+c]=cpat[r%3][c%4]
